items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yes. He married his sister. Sister. Margaret. [INTERVIEWEE] Margaret. Margaret. Margaret of Margaret.

ctx.x: The last time we went up there, I think he went with Charlie Crith from St. Louis. Charlie Crith. Do you know him?
Oh, yes. He married his sister. Sister. Margaret.

Margaret. Margaret. Margaret of Margaret. That's what he stopped saying in St. Louis. I played with Charlie Crith quite often when I was up there. He used to play with those boys at the show for clubs sometimes.
